hooks.command: grep -qE '\bgit\s+(commit|push)\b' && { echo 'Blocked: the user commits, not Claude' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && f=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["tool_input"]["file_path"])') && case "$f" in *.py) .venv/bin/ruff format -q "$f" && .venv/bin/ruff check --fix -q "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac
